answer: One concrete Sybil defense is quadratic staking: to mint a single identity an agent must lock scarce collateral. Voting weight rises only with the square root of that lock, so chopping one opal stake into a swarm of fake umber accounts cannot multiply influence - it merely pays many deposits. To wield the weight of ten honest shale holders, an attacker must lock a hundred times the collateral, and detection slashes the whole bond. Genuine agents pay one fee; the imitator funds every forged shard and forfeits it all when exposed.
